overview: PortfolioIQ is a smart investment portfolio manager for Indian investors. Track holdings, get daily stock picks, analyze risk with Sharpe ratio and volatility metrics, set rebalancing alerts, benchmark against S&P 500, and review tax implications — all in one clean dashboard. Built by Aviral Prasad.
features: Broker auto-suggest dropdown with 11+ Indian brokers (Zerodha, Groww, Upstox, Angel One, and more)
Daily mock stock recommendations with expected returns and risk ratings
Holdings management: add, edit, delete stocks with live gain/loss
Advanced risk metrics: Sharpe ratio, portfolio volatility, rebalancing alerts at 5% drift
Three-bucket tax analysis: STCG, LTCG, and unrealized positions
